verdicts.flaw_description: A competing cause reached every unit: "The lubricant supply moved from mineral to synthetic grade mid-cycle, and every machine here drew from that supply." A mineral-to-synthetic grease change plausibly extends bearing life on its own, so the 260-410 extra hours cannot be attributed to the redesigned bearing.

The measured population is far wider than the treated one: "Yields cover every hectare in each block fitted with the line, and the line watered about a quarter of each block's hectares intermittently." Roughly three quarters of the hectares counted in the 0.4-0.7 t/ha gain never got drip water, so the gain must come from something else.

Two of the four cases have the outcome measured before the intervention: case one was "fed 3 August" but stood taller "by 20 June", and case three was "fed 2 May" but measured "by 19 April". Growth recorded before the fertilizer was applied cannot have been caused by it.

A change that hits the exact outcome measure reached every cohort: "The free trial ran eighteen days, up from ten in the earlier period, and every cohort here signed up on that trial." Week-two (day 14) retention falls inside an 18-day trial but outside a 10-day one, so the 3-6 point lift is explained by the longer trial.

The timings are measured on a self-selected subset: "Timings cover the runs that stayed on the issued route, and about a sixth of each depot's runs left the issued route." The excluded sixth are exactly the runs where the new route was abandoned (plausibly the slow, problem runs), so the 5-9 minute saving is not the effect of the routing change on deliveries generally.

The absence figures drop the non-compliers: "Absence figures cover the pupils on the revised timetable throughout, and about a fifth of each cohort spent weeks on the old timetable." The excluded fifth are selected on post-switch behaviour, so the 4-7 percent lower absence measures a compliant subgroup rather than the cohort the timetable change was applied to.
